competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times. Each attack has a 25% chance to increase the enemy's chance of dealing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Attacks an enemy and then removes all beneficial effects on the target. If there are 2 or more beneficial effects removed, the Attack Bar of all allies will be increased by 20% each.

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: A randomly selected ally also attacks when you attack during your turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Brings one or more allies to attack at the same time.
